injuries.reason: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
Markkanen has been diagnosed with a non-displaced fracture in his right hand and will be sidelined for at least one month, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Hayes (knee) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against the Clippers.

Nurkic (toe) has begun participating in on-court activities as he continues recovering from a right foot injury sustained during an Oct. 4 preseason game against Denver. He will be re-evaluated in two weeks, the Jazz announced Friday.
Reaves (heel) is out for Tuesday's game against the Hornets, Dave McMenamin of ESPN.com reports.
Head coach JJ Redick said he expects Walker (leg) to be available for Wednesday's game against the Jazz, Thuc Nhi Nguyen of the Los Angeles Times reports.
